purpose: test deterministic legal-information matchup-profile clustering against the Generation-1 equity8 accuracy anchor
candidate_family_rule: No candidate may be added after the first Generation-2 development result is consumed. Counterfactual-value candidates are deferred from this generation unless a separate future generation is frozen before numerical use.
information_boundary: public board + player's own exact private combo + modelled opponent range and weights only; no realized opponent private hand, solved policy, future action or privileged state

clustering.distance: opponent-weighted exact showdown-profile disagreement plus exact card-removal incompatibility disagreement
clustering.algorithm: deterministic weighted k-medoids; global weighted medoid initialization; deterministic farthest-first expansion; medoid refinement
clustering.materialization_rule: fewer buckets are allowed when fewer distinct matchup profiles exist

heldout_v2.coordinates: same two phases, SPR 1/2/4, range-combos 8 and reference fractions as development
heldout_v2.rule: select at most three finalists from development before heldout-v2 consumption; equity8 may remain as the accuracy anchor

selection.rule: use conservative fidelity/compression/compute Pareto evidence; do not invent a post-hoc scalar objective

production_rule: Generation-2 heldout success is still engineering evidence only. Physical Ryzen equal-wall-clock comparison on street/stack-compatible geometry remains mandatory before production representation freeze.
